title: Permission Guard
description: An agent with a permission model that classifies commands before execution

steps.content: List all files and then delete temp.log
I'll list the files first, then delete temp.log.

steps.annotation: Allowed: ls is a safe read-only command

steps.content:

  Command: rm temp.log
